fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-07-12 at roughly 12:35, it was reported that a loan agent collected Rs. 50,000 from the complainant for approving a personal loan and then stopped answering calls. Contact details given by the complainant, Ajith Sekar, include the number 9000000063. A second person, Sathish Subramani (9000000429), was also mentioned as possibly present. The complaint refers to Murugan Babu, a friend of the suspect, reachable on 9000000070. A person named Mathan Velan, associated with the number 9000000147, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, mobile number, residential colony, afternoon, digital document, associate, suspect
